codes.meaning: The site or the connector does not speak the job's protocol version; the Brain queues v2 jobs only for a site that declared protocol 2.
The Brain has no site declaration for this certificate; Link sends PUT /secured/connector/v2/site first.
The connector serving the job's source did not declare this action; nothing is previewed or written.
A parameter is missing, unknown or not of the kind the declaration states.
The action did not declare the job's staging (direct or native_review).
Several steps in one act job for an action whose grouping is none.
The connector cannot compute the change exactly; the preview says exact false and the action cannot be approved.
The change would set a field the source computes; the preview is inexact.
The target item does not exist in the source.
The target is no longer at the permit's expected version; nothing was written (status conflict).
An act step without a permit; nothing is written.
The permit's tenant, source, action, target, params_sha256 or staging differs from the job's; nothing is written.
The permit's signature does not verify with the key its kid names.
The permit names a key Link has not pinned from the Brain, or one outside its validity.
The permit's expiry passed before its first delivery; nothing is written.
The permit names another site than this Link's; nothing is written.
The permit was used for a different job content before; a repeat of the same content gets the first result instead.
Some steps of an act on a source that cannot group writes were written and some not; each receipt says which.
review_outcome or unstage for a stage_ref the source does not know.
Link could not record the permit in its write log before acting; nothing is written.
